title: Dai Dark
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a space divided between a lit Regular Realm and a lightless Dark Realm, teenage dark alien Zaha Sanko is hunted because legend says his bones grant any wish. With his giant skeletal guardian Avakian, the flippant God of Death Shimada and fellow fugitive Damemaru, he flies the living ship Moja to find whoever is offering a reward for his bones, clashing with the Solar Mass, a light-worshipping theocracy.
life_message: It holds up cheerful defiance and loyalty among outcasts against those who would use them.

content.note: Flesh stripped from bone by Sanko's axe, explosive disintegrations, Shimada feeding on corpses (Wikipedia; AniList Gore 93%, Body Horror 88%).
Body horror and constant lethal danger, softened by dark comedy (Wikipedia; AniList Body Horror; genre Horror).

winners_losers: Sanko and his fugitive crew win against bounty hunters; the Solar Mass theocracy is cast as the oppressor. Sympathy goes to 'dark' outcasts over 'light' institutions.
